D: A handful of Atlanta families, each with its own mum drama, collide in the days before Mother's Day.
P: Serve breakfast in bed food when Mother's Day finally arrives.
S: Croissants filled with almond cream, baked and dusted with icing sugar

Day-old croissants soaked in vanilla syrup, filled and topped with almond cream and flaked almonds, baked golden and dusted with icing sugar. Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water and 1 tsp vanilla for 2 minutes. Beat 80g soft butter, 80g caster sugar, 1 egg and 100g almond meal into a paste. Split 4 croissants, brush the insides with syrup and spread with half the almond cream. Close, spread the rest on top and scatter with 30g flaked almonds. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and serve with jam.
Cheddar and roasted capsicum spread with crackers

Southern pimento cheese of sharp cheddar, roasted red capsicum, mayonnaise and cayenne, served with crackers, celery and pickled okra or cornichons. Finely grate 200g vintage cheddar. Mix with 100g mayonnaise, 80g chopped roasted red capsicum from a jar, 1 tsp Worcestershire, a pinch of cayenne and black pepper until combined but still chunky. Chill 30 minutes. Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with 200g crackers, celery sticks and a few cornichons.
M: Mother's Day ham and spinach frittata
Baked frittata with ham, potato, spinach and feta

A thick oven-baked frittata of ham, spinach, potato and feta, served in wedges with a lemony rocket salad and tomato relish. Boil 300g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Fry 1 sliced onion in 1 tbsp oil in a 26cm ovenproof pan for 5 minutes, add the potato, 150g diced ham and 100g baby spinach and stir until wilted. Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml cream and salt, pour over and scatter with 100g crumbled feta. Cook on low for 5 minutes, then bake at 180C for 15 minutes until set. Serve with rocket dressed in lemon and relish.
W: Buttery scones split with balsamic strawberries and cream

Fluffy buttery shortcake biscuits split and filled with vanilla whipped cream and balsamic macerated strawberries. Slice 300g strawberries and toss with 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp balsamic vinegar and leave 20 minutes. Rub 80g cold butter into 250g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, add 150ml milk and pat out to 2cm. Cut 6 rounds, brush with milk and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla. Split the shortcakes and fill with cream and strawberries.
K: Blood orange juice, orange liqueur and sparkling wine

Chilled sparkling wine topped with fresh blood orange juice and a splash of orange liqueur. Blood orange and soda for the kids. Juice 6 blood oranges or regular oranges and strain. Pour 60ml juice and 10ml orange liqueur into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with chilled sparkling wine, about 100ml per glass. Garnish with a thin orange wheel on the rim. For the kids, mix the rest of the juice with soda water.
